verbetes.glosa_atual: (חוּס) poupança, tolerância, apenas (adverbial) חַס וְשָׁלוֹם tolerância e paz!, Deus me livre!, não diga isso!

notas_originais: Eduy. V, 6 ח' וש' שעקביא וכ' God forbid (to think) that ʿAkabia was excommunicated! Sabb. 138 b ח' וש' שתשתכח וכ' God forbid (to entertain the idea) that the Law will be forgotten &c. B. Mets. 85 b ח' וש' אי וכ' if, which God forfend, the Law should be forgotten &c.—Y. Pes. VI, 33 a bot. (in Chald. phraseology) ח' וש' דהוה בעי לה God forbid (to think) that he would have done it!; a. v. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. próximo w.) ser branco, puro, caridoso, gracioso.
definicoes_originais: (v. next w.) to be white, pure, charitable, graceful.
notas_originais: —Part. pass. חָסוּד, fem. חֲסוּדָה, endowed with חֶסֶד, graceful. Keth. 17 a (in a bridal song) כלה נאה וח' handsome and graceful bride. Num. R. s. 12; Cant. R. to III, 10 (not חסידה).

חִסֵּד, חִשֵּׂד [ to scrape off,] (cmp. גדף, גרף) to jeer, scoff at, to shame. Ruth R. to IV, 8 שחִסְּדָן ברבים (or שחֲסָדָן; ed. Wil. שחשדן) he scoffed at them publicly (speaking ironically, with ref. to II Chr. XIII, 8); Y. Yeb. XVII, beg. 15 c שחִישֵּׂד וכ' he jeered at Jeroboam; Gen. R. s. 65; ib. s. 73 שחסדם ed. Wil. (oth. שחש'); Lev. R. s. 33; Midr. Sam. ch. XVIII שחִיסְּדָן; Yalk. Kings 205 ומְחַשֵּׂד.—Ex. R. s. 30 (ref. to Ex. II, 14) שחִיסְּדוּ וכ' when Dathan and Abiram sneered at him. Ib. בזה שחִיסַּדְתֶּם אותו וכ' with the very word (שופט) with which you sneered at him, I shall give him the rulership (משפטים). Pesik. R. s. 42 מְחַסְּדִים את שרה (not מחסרו') jeered at Sarah; a. e.—V. חִיסּוּד.

Ḥull. 63 a, v. דַּיָּה; ולמה … ח' שעושה חסידות וכ' and she is named ‘the kind’ because she acts kindly with her kind; Midr. Till. to Ps. CIV, 17. Ex. R. s. 35.

notas_originais: Men. 29 a ומי ח' כולי האי Ar. (ed. חסר; Rashi to Taan. 11 a: חֲסִיכֵי, pl.) is there so much reduction (loss in weight by smelting)?— Pl. חֲסִיכֵי; fem. חֲסִיכָן, חֲסִיכָתָא. Targ. Gen. XLI, 19; 20; 27 (interch. with חסיר' a. חסיי', v. חַסְיָא).—Pes. 48 a חיטי ח' poor wheat.
Targ. Is. XXVI, 12 ח' מחובנא a little less that our sins deserved (h. text גם, cmp. גמם).
, v. חֲסַל

definicoes_originais: (= חססית; חסס, cmp. Ar. ḥ assa) peeling plants, alliacea, leek plants.
notas_originais: Ter. X, 10 אלא עם הח' (Ms. M. החִיסוֹת; Y. ed. החִיסִית) except they are combined with leek-plants. Y. ib. 47 b ח' בח' מין במינו if the same species of leek plants (of T’rumah and Ḥullin) are pressed together. Lam. R. to II, 11, v. דִּמְעָה.— Pl. חָסִיּוֹת. Tosef. Ter. IX, 3 אלו הן מיני ח' וכ' (ed. verbetes.glosa_atual: [ raspar,] diminuir, deduzir; restringir, reter.; de sobra, seja atencioso, tolerante.
definicoes_originais: [ to scrape off,] to diminish, deduct; to stint, withhold.
notas_originais: Dem. VII, 3 (4) וחוֹסֵךְ גרוגרת וכ' Ar. a. ed. Y. (Mish. a. Bab. ed. חוֹשֵׂךְ, Ms. M. repeatedly חתך) and retains one fig (which he does not eat). Ib. לא יַחְסוֹךְ (Var. same).— Part. pass. חָסוּךְ stripped, wanting. Kel. I, 2 (וחֲשׂוּכֵי) וחֲסוּכֵי בגדים and to make unclean the persons alone but not their clothes. Erub. 28 a חֲסוּכֵי בנים Ms. M. a. oth. (ed. חשוכי) those who want children, opp. מרובי בנים.

Tosef. Sot. VI, 7 ח' עליו הכתוב the Biblical text (the Lord) spared him (did not rebuke him). Ib. מְחַסְּכִין לו they (in heaven) spare him. Zeb. 6 b חי' הכתוב the Biblical law has regard to expenses; v. חִיסָּכוֹן.

L, 19 חַסְלַת וכ' the evil is paid off (atoned for; cmp. גמל).—Y. R. Hash. II, 58 b top מן דַחֲסַל … מן וכ' when R. … had ceased from praying. Gen. R. s. 17, beg. מן דחַסְלִין (not דמן ח') when they had finished their studies; a. fr.
Targ. Y. II Num. XVII, 23 (h. text גמל).
Targ. I Sam. I, 24 (h. text גמל); a. fr.
. Targ. O. Deut. XXVIII, 38.

Targ. Y. II Gen. XLVI, 18.—Y. Bicc. I, 64 a מְחַסֵּל לה finished the sentence (by adding a general rule). Cant R. beg. זימנין מח' לה וכ' sometimes he goes through the entire alphabet &c.; (Koh. R. to I, 13 חשל); a. fr.
Targ. O. Gen. XXI, 8 (ed. Berl. אִתְחַ'); a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: cmp. precedeu. wds., esp. חָסַךְ) [ reter, prevenir, v. Ez. XXXIX, 11,]; para amordaçar, esp. evitar que o animal coma durante o trabalho (com referência ao Deut. XXV, 4).; para formar a borda de uma cesta ou de uma bolsa de couro.; ser amordaçado, ser impedido de comer durante o trabalho.
definicoes_originais: cmp. preced. wds., esp. חָסַךְ) [ to withhold, prevent, v. Ez. XXXIX, 11,]
to muzzle, esp. to prevent the animal from eating while at work (with ref. to Deut. XXV, 4).
to form the rim of basket work or of a leather bag.
to be muzzled, to be prevented from eating while at work.
to be bent into a rim.
notas_originais: B. Mets. 90 a עובר משום בל תַּחְסוֹם he trespasses the law forbidding to muzzle (if he prevents the animal from eating). Ib. חֲסוֹם פרתי muzzle my cow. Ib. b, a. e. חֲסָמָהּ בקול if he prevents her from eating by shouting at her; a. fr.—Trnsf. (an adaptation of Deut. l. c. which is followed by the law concerning leviratical marriage) to tie a woman to a man ( Yabam) with whom she cannot live; [Rashi: to shut a woman’s mouth, ignore her objections]. Yeb. 4 a שאין חוֹסְמִין אותה that we do not coërce her (to be the wife of a leper).
Kel. XVI, 2; 3; 4.
B. Mets. 89 a לאקושי חֹוסֵם לנֶחְסָם וכ' to draw a parallel between the muzzler (human laborer) and the muzzled (laboring brute).
Kel. XX, 2.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , para amordaçar; trnsf. silenciar.; Isso. אִתְחֲסַם, אִיחֲ' ser amordaçado, silenciado.
definicoes_originais: Ithpe. אִתְחֲסַם, אִיחֲ' to be muzzled, silenced.
notas_originais: Sot. 35 a וחַסְמִין לי and they will silence me. Snh. 32 b
Targ. Ps. XXXII, 9. Ib. CVII, 42.—Snh. l. c. ולִיחַסְּמוּ let them be silenced (intimidated).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (cmp. חסל) descascar, raspar, polir, esmaltar, endurecer (aço).; para ser esmaltado.
definicoes_originais: (cmp. חסל) to peel, scrape, to polish, glaze, harden ( steel).
notas_originais: Tosef. Shebi. VI, 10; Y. ib. VIII, 38 b bot. אין חוֹסְמִין וכ' you must not use it for glazing stoves or ranges. Tosef. Bets. III, 16 כדי לחוֹסְמָן for the purpose of glazing them; Bets. 34 a לחַסְּמָן ( Pi.).—Y. M. Kat. I, end, 81 a, v. infra.—[Tosef. Dem. IV, 12 משיחסום, read: משיתנם?]
same. Bets. l. c., v. supra. Ib. מפני שצריך לחַסְּמָן because it is necessary to glaze the tiles (by heating them).
Y. M. Kat. I, end, 81 a [read:] ואין מפיגין אותן בצונן כדי שיִתְחַסְּמוּ nor must you cool them off suddenly in order that they may be glazed (hardened). V. חִיסּוּם.

verbetes.glosa_atual: [para raspar, cmp. גמגם, חָכַךְ II] hesitar, não ter certeza do que fazer.; receber uma borda de aço; trnsf. (da boca) para poder falar.; esfregar contra, trnsf. (cmp. גָּרַר) procurar uma briga, competir (v. P. Sm. 1333).
definicoes_originais: [ to scrape, cmp. גמגם, חָכַךְ II] to hesitate, be uncertain what to do.
to receive a steel edge; trnsf. (of the mouth) to become able to speak.
to rub against, trnsf. (cmp. גָּרַר) to seek a quarrel, to vie with (v. P. Sm. 1333).
notas_originais: Part. pass. חֲסִים bright and hard, flinty.— Pl. חֲסִימִין. Targ. Y. II Deut. VIII, 9; (Y. I שאילן מסימן, read: הֲסִימַן fem. pl.). Targ. Y. ib. XXXIII, 25.
Sabb. 147 a הוה קא מְחַסֵּם וכ' he hesitated to hand it to him. Keth. 20 b. B. Mets. 23 b. Ḥull. 50 a. [Ar. a. some Mss. have הסם; v. Koh. Ar. Compl. s. v. הסם a. Rabb. D. S. to B. Mets. l. c.]

Lev. R. s. 23; Cant. R. to II, 2 אתח' ר' וכ' R. E. (who on a former occasion was unable to pronounce a blessing) has received a steel edge, and they named him R. E. Ḥisma; [Ar.: הא חֲסִים אלעזר, v. supra].
Targ. Prov. XXIV, 19 (h. text תתחר).

verbetes.glosa_atual: ser forte.; (cmp. חזק) para tomar posse (principalmente em Af.).; para fortalecer.; mesmo. Targ. O. Gen. XLIX, 24. Targ. Sou. II, 14 (h. texto mesmo.
definicoes_originais: (cmp. חזק) to take possession (mostly in Af.).
same. Targ. O. Gen. XLIX, 24. Targ. Am. II, 14 (h. text same.
to take possession (for one’s self and heirs).
(cmp. חָזַק Hif.) to hold, have room for.
to strengthen one’s self, to betake one’s self; to control one’s own emotions.
notas_originais: [Targ. Is. LXIII, 15, v. Ithpa.]—V. חוּסְנָא
Targ. Is. XXXV, 3 (h. text אמץ).
Targ. O. Gen. XLIX, 24. Targ. Am. II, 14 (h. text אמץ); a. e.

Targ. Ps. XXXVII, 29. Targ. O. Lev. XXV, 46 (Y. תִחְסְ', Pe.); a. fr.—B. Bath. 148 b bot. אף יַחְסִין וירת וכ' also if he uses the expression ya ḥ sin, he shall take possession, or yereth, he shall inherit, referring to an heir.
Targ. O. Deut. XXXII, 8 באחסנא (Y. באַחְסָנוּת verbal noun, constr.). Targ. Y. I Num. XI, 26.
Targ. Am. II, 6; VIII, 6 (h. text נעלים, v. נַעַל).
Y. Snh. X, 29 a top (ref. to II Kings VI, 1) לא א' אוכלוסייא וכ' (not אסחין) it did no longer hold the masses &c.
Targ. Jer. III, 8. Targ. Is. LXIII, 15 ed. Lag. (oth. ed. יֶחְסְ').—Targ. O. Gen. XLIII, 31 (v. זְרַז). Targ. I Sam. XIII, 12; a. fr. (h. text התאפק).
Targ. Job VII, 3 (h. text הָנְחַלְתִּי).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (= חֲסַל I), Af. אַחְסֵין desmamar.; ser desmamado.; ser totalmente compensado.
definicoes_originais: (= חֲסַל I), Af. אַחְסֵין to wean.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Gen. XXI, 8.
. Ib.
Targ. Prov. XI, 31 (h. text יְשֻׁלָּם).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (חֲסַן); força, poder.; fortaleza, armazém (b. h. חֹסֶן).
notas_originais: Dan. II, 37; v. חוּסְנָא.
— Pl. חִסְנַיָּא. Targ. Joel I, 17 Ar. (ed. Lag. חוּסְנַיָּא; v. אִסְנָא).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (cmp. חָסַל) descascar; (verbo neutro) ser escamoso, áspero.; para triturar grãos etc. Y. Sabb. VII, 10 b bot. ח' פלפלין libras de pimenta (cmp. מחספס, Ex. XVI, 14).; [para ficar branco, cmp. כסף,] sentir vergonha.
definicoes_originais: (cmp. חָסַל) to peel off; (neut. verb) to be scaly, rough.
to pound grain &c. Y. Sabb. VII, 10 b bot. ח' פלפלין pounds pepper (cmp. מחספס, Ex. XVI, 14).
[ to become white, cmp. כסף,] to feel ashamed.
notas_originais: [Y. B. Mets. II, 8 c bot. וחספתה, v. חֲפַס.]
Targ. II Esth. VI, 12.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (precedido.) (= h. חֶרֶשׂ); argila áspera, מאנא דח' vaso de barro (comum e facilmente quebrável).; [algo para descascar ou raspar,] fragmento de um vaso, caco de cerâmica.
definicoes_originais: rough clay, מאנא דח' clay vessel (common and easily broken).
[ something with which to peel or scrape,] fragment of a vessel, potsherd.
notas_originais: (common and easily broken). Targ. O. Lev. XI, 33; a. e.

Targ. Prov. XXVI, 23.—Yeb. 92 b, a. e., v. דְּלֵי. Kidd. 18 a (prov.) נקיט … יהיבנא ליה ח' he had a pearl in his hand, and we give him a sherd, i.e. for a valuable object we give him a valueless paper; a. fr.— Pl. חַסְפִּין, חִ'. Gen. R. s. 14, v. דְּבַק; Midr. Till. to Ps. II; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (חסף; cmp. כסופא) vergonha; (cmp. b. h. בּשֶׁת) ídolo.
definicoes_originais: (חסף; cmp. כסופא) shame; (cmp. b. h. בּשֶׁת) idol.
notas_originais: Y. Ned. I, 37 a top (in answer to the question, ‘Does not ḥ eres mean a sherd?’) לשון אומות … קריין לח' כספא ( ḥ eres may be used as a substitute for חֵרֶם) for it is a gentile dialect, the Nabatæans say ḥ ispa for kispa (כסופא) (which means shame or idol); Y. Naz. I, beg. 51 a (corr. acc.); v. Ned. 10 b top.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Ḥ aspiah (Hasbeya), uma cidade fronteiriça no norte da Palestina.
definicoes_originais: Ḥ aspiah ( Hasbeya), a border town in Northern Palestine.
notas_originais: Y. Dem. II, 22 d top; Tosef. Shebi. IV, 10 צפיח ed. Zuck. (Var. חצפיא, צפיא).
Num. R. s. 19; Koh. R. to VII, 23 רגלוי … לח' דנונא the feet of chickens resemble (as to their covering) the scale-covered skin of the fish, v. חַרְסְפִיתִין.
Sabb. 133 b, sq. האי מאן דמשי … ליה ח' (Ms. M. חוספנתא) he who washes his face and does not dry it well, will get a scab. Ab. Zar. 28 b, sq. (Rashi: חוס').

verbetes.glosa_atual: [ raspar,] diminuir, tirar; ser diminuído, menos; querer, senhorita; ser imperfeito.; diminuir, omitir; privar.
definicoes_originais: [ to scrape off,] to diminish, take off; to be diminished, less; to want, miss; to be imperfect.
notas_originais: Snh. 68 a ולא חָסַרְתִּי מרבותי וכ' yet I skimmed of the knowledge of my teachers no more than a dog takes who licks out of the sea. Ib. ולא חֲסָרוּנִי וכ' they skimmed of my knowledge &c.; Cant. R. to I, 3 לא חֲסַרְתִּיהָ וכ' what wisdom I skimmed of the Law, was no more than &c., v. זַכְרוּת. Ib. רבותי חֲסָרוּהָ וכ' my teachers carried off at least a real smattering of it &c. B. Kam. 20 a bot. מאי חֲסַרְתִּיךָ what loss have I occasioned to thee?—Ib. b, a. fr. זה נהנה … חָסֵר the one profits while the other loses nothing (therefore can claim no damages). Lev. R. s. 1 מה חָסַרְתָּ, v. דֵּעָה. Men. 30 a, a. e. is it possible ס"ת ח' אות וכ' that the Book of the Law wanted one letter yet (to be written) &c.?—Pesik. R. s. 3 (ref. to מתה עלי, Gen. XLVIII, 7) שחֲסרְתִּיהָ for I miss her; a. fr.

Ker. 6 a חי' אחת וכ' if he left out one of its ingredients. Erub. 13 a שמא אתה מְחַסֵּר וכ' for if thou omit one letter. Koh. R. to I, 15 (ref. to חסרון, ib.) משאדם מְחַ' עצמו וכ' as soon as a man deprives himself of the words of the Law (neglecting them); ib. מַחֲסִיר ( Hif.). Y. Snh. XI, beg. 30 a אפי' לא חי' even if on inflicting an injury (v. חַבּוּרָה) he did not create a diminution (open wound); a. fr.— Part. pass. מְחוּסָּר, constr. מְחוּסַּר wanting, requiring. R. Hash. 6 a מח' זמן wanting time, i.e. too young for sacrifice. Ker. II, 1 מח' כפרה requires a ceremony of atonement (before he may partake of a sacred meal). Gen. R. s. 32, a. e. מח' אמנה, v. אֲמָנָה I. Ḥull. 25 a, v. חֲטִיטָה.—Y. B. Mets. V, 10 c bot. מח' מעשה אחד wanting one action to be available; a. fr.— Pl. constr. מְחוּסְּרֵי. Ker. l. c. ארבעה מ' וכ' there are four persons requiring a ceremony of atonement before being permitted &c., v. supra; a. fr.
same, v. supra.

verbetes.glosa_atual: mesmo, v. supra.—2); diminuir, privar, reduzir.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Ex. XVI, 18 (O. ed. Berl. חַסָּר, oth. ed. חֲסַר, חַסִּיר) had less. Targ. Deut. II, 7; a. fr.—Nidd. 68 a חַסְרַת, v. דּוּדָא; a. e.

Targ. Ps. VIII, 6. Targ. Koh. IV, 8; a. fr.—Snh. 22 a חַסְּרֵיה וכ' v. גַּנָּבָא; a. e.— Part. pass. מְחַסַּר (v. preced. Pi.) wanting. Targ. Y. Num. XI, 32.—Bets. 24 a; Bekh. 39 a, a. fr. חַסּוּרֵי מְחַסְּרָא (or מִיחַסְּרָא Ithpa.) the relation is defective (a clause has been omitted).

verbetes.glosa_atual: querendo, defeituoso; menos.; criando um defeito.
notas_originais: Sabb. VII, 2 ארבעים ח' אחת forty (labors) less one. B. Bath. VII, 2, v. הֵן. Ib. 89 b מדה ח' וכ' a measure too small or too large. Tosef. Taan. I, 2 אם … השנה ח' if the year had a deficiency of rain; Y. ib. I, 64 b; a. fr.— Pl. חֲסֵירִים, … רִין; חֲסֵירוֹת. Macc. 23 a חֲסֵירֵי כח of feeble physics; a. fr.—Esp. a) (calendar) חָסֵר a defective month (of 29 days), opp. מלא of thirty days. B. Mets. 59 b ואיחליף מלא לח' … and he made a mistake between a full and a defective month (thought it was the thirtieth day of the preceding month). R. Hash. 19 b; a. fr.— Pl. as ab. Ib.— b) (orthogr.) a defective writing, omission of the vowel letter, opp. מלא (plene), e. g. חֹדֶשׁ, plene חוֹדֶשׁ.— Pl. f. חֲסֵירוֹת. Erub. 13 a; Kidd. 30 a ח' ויתרות the rules concerning defective and plene; a. fr.

Ḥag. 3 b (ref. to Koh. XII, 11) אי מה … ח' וכ' you might think, as the nail (driven in) creates a hole and not an addition, אף ד"ת חֲסֵירִין וכ' so do the words of the Law &c.; Yalk. Koh. 989 end אף ד"ת מְחַסְּרִין וכ'.

Targ. I Kings XI, 22. Targ. I Sam. XXI, 16; a. fr.—Targ. II Esth. III, 8 חד ח' one month is defective (of 29 days).— Pl. חֲסֵרִין, חֲסֵי'. Targ. Prov. XXVII, 12 (ed. Wil. חַסְרִין, v. חֲסַר).—Targ. II Esth. l. c. (ed. Lag. חֲסוֹרִין) starving
Keth. 66 b, v. מֶלַח.

—ח' כיס loss of money. Sabb. 157 a, a. fr., v. מוּקְצֶה. Kidd. 32 b שאין בה ח' כיס with which no material loss is connected. Lev. R. s. 5 המקום ימלא חֶסְרוֹנְךָ the Lord replace thy deficiency; Ber. 16 b. Tosef. Taan. I, 2 נותנין לה חִיסְּרוֹנָהּ the year’s deficiency (of rain) will be supplied to him (who prays); Y. ib. I, 64 b חסרונה. Ib. d top (ref. to Job XXX, 3) אם ראית ח' בא וכ' when thou seest scarcity &c.; (Gen. R. s. 31; s. 34 חוֹסֶר), v. גַּלְמוּד. Ḥull. 47 b, a. fr. נקב שיש בו ח' a perforation connected with a loss of substance. Ib.; Bekh. 39 a, a. e. ח' מבפנים … ח' a deficiency of substance inside of an organ is not considered a defect (in ritual law); a. fr.
, v. חוּסְרָנָא
, v. חוף, חפף.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (cmp. bh חֹף; חפף I); fronteira, costa.; (cmp. חִיפָּא) [ borda, cume,] proteção de uma fechadura (פותחת); pedaço de chave (correspondente à enfermaria); pivô de uma porta (v. Sm. Ant. s. vv. Cardo, Clavis).; a borda de uma teia, usada para iniciar uma nova teia, fixando a urdidura nela.
definicoes_originais: (cmp. חִיפָּא) [ rim, ridge,] ward of a lock (פותחת); bit of a key (corresponding to the ward); pivot of a door (v. Sm. Ant. s. vv. Cardo, Clavis).
the border of a web, used for starting a new web by fastening the warp to it.
notas_originais: Num. R. s. 13 (ref. to Num. VII, 26) אין כף אלא חף וכ' Kaf (bowl) means the same as ḥ af (shore), as it is said (Ps. XCVIII, 8) rivers strike the Kaf.

Sabb. VIII, 6 כדי … חף bone large enough to make of it a ḥ af; expl. ib. 81 a חַפֵּי פותחת the rims (ward) of a lock; Y. ib. 11 b bot מהו חף סרגיד what ḥ af is meant? (Answ.) the key-ward; ib. תמן היא עביד חף בלוט וכ' (not כלוט) there (Kel. XIV, 8) he (R. Judah) uses ḥ af in the sense of a key-bit, and here (Sabb. l. c.) in the sense of a key-ward.

Y. ib. VII, 10 c, v. נִיר IV.— Pl. חַפִּים, חַפִּין. Kel. XIII, 6 פותחת של עץ וח' וכ' if the lock is of wood and its key-bits of metal (ed. Dehr. חָפִין). Ib. XIV, 8 ניטלו ח' if the teeth of the bit are broken off (damaged). Sabb. 81 a, v. supra. Y. ib. IV, 7 a top חַפֵּי לסוטות borders used for weaving veils. Cant. R. to III, 10 (expl. פתות, I Kings VII, 50) חפיפות, read: חַפֵּי פותחות the pivots; (Pesik. R. s. 6 בלוטין שבפותחות, v. בָּלוּט).—Kel. XI, 4 הַפִּין = החפין.
, v. חפי
, v. הִיפָּטִיקוֹס

verbetes.glosa_atual: (pl. de חֳפִי; חָפָה) cobrindo vasos de barro queimado.
definicoes_originais: (pl. of חֳפִי; חָפָה) covering over burnt clay vessels.
notas_originais: Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. III, 14; ib. Par. V (IV), 2 (לח') גילה ח' וכ' ed. Zuck. (ed. corrupt) if he removes the covering and finds dust on the vessels (proving that none had touched them; v. R. S. to Par. V, 1 for correct version).
, v. חֵפֶת
, v. חפי

Kel. XVI, 8 (חעשוי) לח' whatever is intended for wrapping, opp. תיק, casing. Ib. XXVI, 6. Tosef. ib. B. Bath. IV, 11; a. e.— Pl. חִפּוּיִם, חִי'. Ib. XVI, 8 חִפּוּיֵ האלה וכ' the wrapping of a lance &c.

Ib. XXII, 4 a bridal chair שנטל חִפּוּיוֹ whose seat is missing; (Eduy. I, 11 חִפּוּיָו, Ms. M. דפניו, Mish. Nap. חופיו, v. Rabad a. l.). Kel. l. c. 6 שנטל חִפּוּיוֹ האמצעי whose middle cushion (of the three forming the seat) is wanting.— Pl. as ab. Ib. 5 שלא היו חִפּוּיָו יוצאין (ed. Dehr. חִפּוּיָיו) whose seats were not movable (v. Rabad to Eduy. l. c.); a. fr.—[Tosef. Sabb. IV (V), 7 כל חיפוי ed. Zuck., read with ed.: נוֹי.]
Targ. Ex. XXXVIII, 17; 19 (h. text צִפּוּי). Targ. Is. XXX, 22.
, v. חִיפּ'
